title: Dance Storyboard
subtitle: 25-panel motion board for a vertical short-video dance sequence

panels.label: Hook silhouette
panels.caption: Open with a strong full-body silhouette and instant attitude.
panels.prompt: front wide shot, hook pose, strong silhouette, dance studio, same protagonist

panels.label: Front hero
panels.caption: Show the protagonist clearly in a stable full-body hero pose.
panels.prompt: full-body front hero pose, same outfit, same studio, confident expression

panels.label: Weight shift
panels.caption: First body shift to start the rhythm.
panels.prompt: subtle weight transfer, knees bent, kinetic posture, same character

panels.label: Arm extension
panels.caption: Extend one arm outward to define the beat.
panels.prompt: medium-wide shot, one arm extended, clean line, same studio

panels.label: Torso twist
panels.caption: Rotate the torso for direction change.
panels.prompt: torso twist, diagonal stance, athletic tension, same outfit

panels.label: Side rhythm
panels.caption: Switch to a side profile for variety.
panels.prompt: side-profile dance pose, rhythmic motion, same environment

panels.label: Footwork insert
panels.caption: Tight insert on the feet to show stepping detail.
panels.prompt: close shot of footwork, sliding sneakers, floor reflection

panels.label: Head turn
panels.caption: Use a head snap or turn for emphasis.
panels.prompt: close-medium shot, sharp head turn, expressive face

panels.label: Hair motion
panels.caption: Capture hair or fabric motion in mid-beat.
panels.prompt: hair swing, dynamic motion, crisp freeze frame

panels.label: Low-angle power
panels.caption: Make the dancer feel larger and more confident.
panels.prompt: low-angle full-body power pose, dramatic perspective

panels.label: Travel step
panels.caption: Let the dancer move across space.
panels.prompt: traveling step toward camera, full body, same studio

panels.label: Front medium
panels.caption: Pause closer for face and chest energy.
panels.prompt: front medium shot, smile and dance posture, same protagonist

panels.label: Hand detail
panels.caption: Focus on expressive hands or gesture language.
panels.prompt: hand choreography detail, expressive fingers, same lighting

panels.label: Half spin
panels.caption: Show the spin building before the peak.
panels.prompt: half-turn spin, skirt or fabric lifting, same dancer

panels.label: Spin midpoint
panels.caption: Freeze the most dynamic spin instant.
panels.prompt: spin midpoint, motion-rich frame, dynamic hair and limbs

panels.label: Spin exit
panels.caption: Catch the dancer exiting the rotation.
panels.prompt: spin exit, grounded stance returning, same studio

panels.label: Landing stance
panels.caption: A stable landing before the next burst.
panels.prompt: landing stance, balanced feet, controlled posture

panels.label: Charisma close-up
panels.caption: Bring in performer charisma through the face.
panels.prompt: close portrait, confident smile, sweat glow, same dancer

panels.label: Diagonal pose
panels.caption: Use a diagonal shape to avoid flat repetition.
panels.prompt: diagonal full-body pose, one hand high, one hand low

panels.label: Backward step
panels.caption: Create a small retreat or pullback beat.
panels.prompt: backward step, playful energy, same outfit

panels.label: Climax hero
panels.caption: Peak performance moment with full-body clarity.
panels.prompt: climax pose, wide frame, full-body energy, same studio

panels.label: Wide reset
panels.caption: Give the viewer one breath before the ending.
panels.prompt: wide reset, relaxed shoulders, preparing for ending pose

panels.label: Final accent
panels.caption: Add one last sharp accent or beat hit.
panels.prompt: sharp final beat, kinetic arm line, same protagonist

panels.label: Hold pose
panels.caption: Hold the end shape for readability.
panels.prompt: held end pose, stable body line, direct eye contact

panels.label: Loop reset
panels.caption: Finish with a frame that can restart the loop cleanly.
panels.prompt: loop-ready ending pose, graceful reset, same studio, same dancer
